skill.name: ai-video-generation
skill.description: Route text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-extension requests to documented RunComfy models, then generate clips with the runcomfy CLI.
skill.summary: Route each video request to a documented RunComfy model and prepare generation from text, images, audio, or existing video.
skill.author: skills-collective

security_audit.summary: The 154 static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, fixed CLI examples, public links, model guidance, and a documented protected token path. The only contextual concern is low-severity third-party processing because RunComfy receives prompts and referenced media during generation.

remediation.issue: Prompts and referenced media may contain private information that leaves the local environment.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose RunComfy processing before submission and obtain confirmation before sending sensitive prompts, images, audio, or video references.

content.value_statement: Choosing a video model and formatting its inputs takes time. This skill selects a suitable RunComfy route and prepares the generation request.
actual_capabilities: Routes text prompts to HappyHorse, Wan, Seedance, Kling, and other documented text-to-video models.
Routes source images by realism, motion, quality, and cost requirements.
Prepares RunComfy requests with documented model identifiers, input fields, durations, aspect ratios, and output directories.
Supports audio-guided lip sync through Wan and in-prompt audio generation through compatible models.
Guides Veo video extension and model selection for longer or multi-shot sequences.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, an authenticated account, network access, and any applicable service credits.
Sends prompts and referenced media to RunComfy for remote processing.
Model availability, schemas, prices, duration limits, and output quality can change.
Does not edit clips locally or guarantee identity, physics, lip sync, or audio quality.

use_cases.title: Produce Vertical Social Clips
use_cases.description: Turn a short concept or still image into a vertical clip with suitable duration, motion, and audio guidance.

use_cases.title: Animate Product Images
use_cases.description: Select a realism-focused model and direct controlled camera or object motion for product marketing footage.

use_cases.title: Plan Cinematic Sequences
use_cases.description: Choose multi-reference or multi-shot models for consistent characters, cinematic camera language, and extended scenes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Text-to-Video Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a [duration]-second [aspect ratio] video of [subject] performing [action], with [camera movement], [lighting], and [audio]. Choose the best model.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Still Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate [image URL]. Keep [elements] stable while [subject] performs [motion]. Use [camera direction], [aspect ratio], and [duration].

prompt_templates.title: Synchronize a Voiceover
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration]-second speaking scene using [audio URL]. Preserve [speaker description], match lip movement, and use [lighting] with [camera framing].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Reference Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cinematic sequence using [subject references], [scene references], and [audio references]. Define [shot sequence], [transitions], [lens], and [final format].

output_examples.input: Create an eight-second widescreen beach scene with a moving kite, warm sunset light, and natural ambient audio.
output_examples.output: Selected HappyHorse 1.0 for general text-to-video with native audio. Prepared an eight-second, 16:9 generation request with subject-first motion guidance.

output_examples.input: Animate a product photo with a precise half rotation while every background element remains still.
output_examples.output: Selected Veo 3-1 for controlled motion and object permanence. Prepared an image-to-video request specifying a 180-degree rotation and no other motion.

output_examples.input: Create a six-second portrait video that follows my supplied voiceover.
output_examples.output: Selected Wan 2-7 for audio-driven lip sync. Prepared a speaking-scene request using the supplied audio reference and portrait description.

best_practices: Describe one clear subject, action, camera movement, lighting setup, duration, format, and audio requirement.
Use only media URLs supplied for the task, and confirm before sending sensitive assets.
Test with a faster or lower-cost tier before generating the final high-quality clip.
anti_patterns: Do not place API tokens, private credentials, or confidential text inside generation prompts.
Do not promise exact identity, physics, lip sync, audio, or continuity across every model output.
Do not submit third-party media without permission or clear usage rights.

faq.question: What must I install?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI and authenticate with a RunComfy account before generating videos.

faq.question: Does this skill generate videos locally?
faq.answer: No. It submits generation inputs to RunComfy and downloads the completed result.

faq.question: Which inputs can I use?
faq.answer: Supported routes include text prompts, source images, audio references, video references, and existing videos for extension.

faq.question: How does it choose a model?
faq.answer: It compares input type, quality, speed, cost, realism, audio, lip sync, duration, and multi-shot requirements.

faq.question: Can it create audio or lip sync?
faq.answer: Yes. Compatible models support in-pass audio, while Wan supports lip motion driven by a supplied audio file.

faq.question: How are credentials and media handled?
faq.answer: The CLI protects stored tokens with mode 0600. Prompts and referenced media are processed by RunComfy.
